description: This file defines the 'Person' class, a subclass of Basic, representing a person object within a SuiteCRM or SugarCRM environment. It includes properties for personal information, methods for name formatting, data retrieval, saving, and lawful basis management, as well as related hooks and address handling.

classes.name: Person
classes.description: Represents a person entity with attributes like name, email, phone, and lawful basis. Includes methods for managing personal data, formatting names based on locale, retrieving and saving data, and setting lawful basis compliance.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a person record by ID, creating proper name fields afterward.

methods.name: fill_in_relationship_fields
methods.description: Populates relationship fields, particularly email addresses.

methods.name: _create_proper_name_field
methods.description: Generates the full name string based on first, last, salutation, and title, respecting locale formatting and ACLs.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the person record, handling email address persistence and address data.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the display name of the person.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Provides data for list views, including email links.

methods.name: populateRelatedBean
methods.description: Copies relevant fields to related beans; specifically handles copying address and contact info for Company beans.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Constructs a SQL query to export person data, including email addresses.

methods.name: setLawfulBasis
methods.description: Sets the lawful basis, source, and review date for data compliance.
